mission: Ben and Talon follow Korda’s response through a Coruscant logistics annex / civic archive loading dock / restricted transit bay. The trail leads to a restricted Foundation/Greyline transfer node. They nearly corner Korda. Korda triggers a prepared escape — a lockdown, a false emergency, a diversion — but Ben and Talon still capture a physical proof object: a restricted field authorization, cargo manifest, courier cylinder, datapad, or Foundation/Greyline transfer record pointing to an offworld Foundation mission. Reader-onboarding / clarity note: Korda is not guarding a dead file. He is guarding an active operation. Plain-language consequence: the Vigil is not just hiding history; they are running a current operation against Jacen’s cache.
why_now: Korda’s indirect response confirmed the Foundation is actively guarding the shipment trail. Following that response now — before Korda can sanitize the route — is the only way to capture physical proof of the active Iresh operation rather than just a pattern of old records.
conflict: Ben and Talon chase Korda through a civic archive loading dock and restricted transit bay to a Foundation/Greyline transfer node — nearly corner him — and have to navigate a prepared lockdown/diversion without getting separated or losing the physical proof Korda drops in his escape. Speed matters more than care, which means Ben is operating closer to the edge than he prefers.
turning_point: Destination: Iresh. The operation is already moving.
closing_hook: Destination: Iresh. The operation is already moving.
setting: Coruscant, a Foundation/Greyline transfer node disguised as a civic archive loading dock in the Verity district — operating under a GA restricted-transit logistics license, the kind the GA Logistics Oversight Bureau issues to post-war archive contractors. Industrial bay doors, courier droids on standard repeating loops, a small office with a Greyline tactical officer on duty. The Verity district's transit infrastructure is woven through with licensed civic-cargo lanes: an inherited feature of post-war Coruscant reconstruction that gives the GA hundreds of legitimately restricted corridors no Jedi has standing to enter. Ben and Talon follow Korda here and nearly corner him; Korda escapes via a prepared lockdown/diversion.

stakes.personal: Ben is moving fast in a space that rewards stillness — reading exits, threat angles, and Korda's camera-avoidance patterns. This is the kind of thinking Jacen's training made automatic in him. He uses it without reflection, and that matters later.
stakes.interpersonal: Korda's prepared escape implies he expected this kind of follow-through — that someone who understood the bait would also understand the route. He is treating Ben and Talon as proficient. That is its own kind of contamination: being taken seriously by someone this operationally clean.
stakes.external: The physical proof object captured — a restricted field authorization, courier cylinder, or Foundation/Greyline transfer record — points to an offworld Foundation mission that is already moving. Korda is not guarding a dead file. He is actively staging a current operation. Destination: Iresh.

sensory_details: The Verity district loading bay has the particular sensory mix of a commercial logistics space trying to look unremarkable: industrial bay door seals that smell of hydraulic fluid, courier droids running on repeating loops, the slightly too-clean signage of a facility that was recently organized. A GA Restricted Transit placard is mounted beside the main bay door — blue and white, standard post-war reconstruction issue. It means Dorrin's writ doesn't cover this space without a separate authorization Ben doesn't have time to file. Korda moves through the space like someone who knows exactly where every camera's lag is — Ben clocks this and adjusts.
canon_elements_needed: GA restricted-transit licensing as post-war reconstruction infrastructure — the civic-logistics machinery Korda hides inside
Coruscant's post-war cargo lane architecture: legitimately restricted corridors that a Jedi without GA standing cannot enter without a separate writ

turning_point_detail.trigger: Korda triggers his prepared escape — lockdown, false emergency, diversion — but in the controlled scramble Ben and Talon capture a physical proof object that was either dropped or left behind in the staging space.
turning_point_detail.shift: The proof object names an offworld Foundation mission: a restricted field authorization or transfer record pointing to Iresh. The operation is already moving.
turning_point_detail.cost: Korda escaped. He'll know they were at the transfer node. Whatever timeline he was managing has just been compressed — and he will report that Ben and Talon are operationally capable, not just investigatively persistent.

emotional_arc.start: Ben is alert and driving — chase logic, threat assessment, the automatic exits-and-angles scan that Jacen's training built.
emotional_arc.shift: Nearly cornering Korda and then watching him escape through a prepared lockdown is frustrating but not surprising. Ben reads Korda's exit patterns and knows they're facing someone who planned for this contingency.
emotional_arc.end: The proof object in hand. Destination confirmed: Iresh. The operation is already moving. Ben and Talon are out of time for careful approach.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben and Talon track Korda's response through the Verity district loading bay, reading his camera-avoidance patterns and following his route to the Foundation/Greyline transfer node.
key_beats.state_change: The investigation moves from Iressa's secondary cache into Greyline's active logistics infrastructure — the trail is live.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The exits-and-angles attention running automatically — tracking Korda's movement with the part of his mind Jacen's training built, not the part he chose.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben and Talon nearly corner Korda in the staging area — close enough that Korda is forced to deploy his prepared escape.
key_beats.state_change: The operational capability of Ben and Talon is now confirmed to Korda — he knows they followed the bait and read the route.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The split-second of almost — the reach that doesn't connect — and the recalibration that follows without time to process it.

key_beats.beat_description: Korda triggers the prepared lockdown: false emergency, diversion, escape route — Ben and Talon navigate it without losing each other.
key_beats.state_change: Korda escapes, but the lockdown reveals how much preparation was invested in this contingency — this transfer node was defended.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Moving through the controlled scramble with the particular attention of someone who is out-resourced and knows it — faster, not harder.

key_beats.beat_description: In the scramble, Ben and Talon capture a physical proof object — a restricted field authorization or Foundation/Greyline transfer record pointing to an offworld Foundation mission.
key_beats.state_change: The investigation produces a physical artifact that cannot be explained as coincidence: Korda is not guarding a dead file.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The object in the hand — the weight of it as the first thing that isn't just information — and the quick decision to move before the value of having it registers.

key_beats.beat_description: The transfer record names an offworld Foundation mission already in motion: destination Iresh.
key_beats.state_change: The operation's location and timeline are confirmed — whatever margin Ben thought he had is gone.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The timeline compressing to something physical — not urgency as an idea but as a specific pressure on the chest.
